entries.3704f285d31397e0: Functional peptides, such as Kyua Peptin, which has antibacterial activity, and functional short peptides such as OSK9/AAP, are sold through cosmetic raw material trading companies and sales companies. OSK9 is incorporated as a beauty ingredient in Albion Co., Ltd.'s cosmetic product Anfines. The consolidated subsidiary FunPep Healthcare Co., Ltd. conducts R&D and sales of functional peptides for the cosmetics field and others.

entries.4369a734a317d5e5: Using the drug discovery platform technology STEP UP, which uses the functional peptide AJP001 as a carrier, the company is developing peptide therapeutic vaccines that produce antibodies against the body's own proteins within patients' bodies. The development candidates are FPP003, targeting the protein IL-17A (for plaque psoriasis and ankylosing spondylitis); FPP004X, targeting IgE (for pollinosis, with a Phase I clinical trial started in Japan in March 2025); and FPP005, targeting IL-23 (for plaque psoriasis, at the preclinical stage).

entries.8633e74ad299144a: The Group consists of the company and one consolidated subsidiary, FunPep Healthcare Co., Ltd., and is a single-segment business conducting R&D on functional peptides based on research results from the Graduate School of Medicine, Osaka University. In addition to developing the antibody-inducing peptide, which produces antibodies in the body, and SR-0379, a functional peptide for skin ulcer treatment, it sells functional peptides for the cosmetics field. Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥314 thousand.
